attchmntText: Orient Cables (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of un-audited Financial Results for Quarter II and Half Year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Orient Cables published unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. ADC India Communications opened a special window for transfer and dematerialization of physical securities sold or purchased prior to April 1, 2019, valid until February 4, 2027. Crown Lifters approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. W.S. Industries approved unaudited financial results for the same period. Garment Mantra Lifestyle approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Oneindia Tech approved unaudited financial results for the quarter ended December 30, 2026. The company issued 28,80,000 new equity shares at Rs. 96 per share, raising Rs. 2,764.80 lakhs. The paid-up equity share capital increased from Rs. 804.42 lakhs to Rs. 1,092.42 lakhs.

attchmntText: Orient Cables (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Orient Cables Reports Highest-Ever Quarterly & Half-Yeary Results in Q2 & H1 FY27;Revenue Doubles to ₹1,018.0 Crore and EBITDA Grows 155% YoY".
voiceSummary: Orient Cables India Limited filed a press release regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 107% year-on-year to Rs. 528.8 crore, while H1 FY27 revenue increased 103% to Rs. 1,018.0 crore. Standalone EBITDA for Q2 rose 158% to Rs. 63.6 crore with margins at 12.0%. Profit after tax for Q2 stood at Rs. 40.1 crore, up 180% year-on-year. Consolidated revenue for Q2 was Rs. 529.3 crore. The company is establishing an 11-acre facility in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, with completion expected by H1 FY28. A joint venture with Aditya Infotech is set to commence commercial production in Q4 FY27.

attchmntText: Orient Cables (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Orient Cables India Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue grew 107 percent year on year to 528.8 crore rupees in Q2 and 103 percent to 1,018.0 crore rupees in H1. EBITDA increased 158 percent to 63.6 crore rupees in Q2 and 155 percent to 119.2 crore rupees in H1. Profit after tax rose 180 percent to 40.1 crore rupees in Q2 and 194 percent to 73.7 crore rupees in H1. The company utilized 155.5 crore rupees from IPO proceeds received on October 5, 2026, for debt repayment. Expansion includes an 11-acre facility in Bhiwadi expected by H1 FY28 and a joint venture with Aditya Infotech targeting production from Q4 FY27.

attchmntText: Orient Cables (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Orient Cables India Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Limited Reviewed Financial Results for Quarter-II and the Half Year ended September 30, 2026, for the Financial Year 2026-27. This approval covers both Standalone and Consolidated financial statements, along with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors. The meeting commenced at 05:30 P.M. and concluded at 06:03 P.M. The approved financial results are available as Annexure-A in the filing and will be hosted on the Company’s website at https://orientcables.in/.

attchmntText: Orient Cables (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Orient Cables India Limited has rescheduled its investors and analysts meetings. The meetings were originally scheduled for Tuesday, 17th November 2026, at 9:00 am IST. They are now moved to Monday, 16th November 2026, at 2:00 pm. This change is due to exigencies. The discussions will rely on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed. The company notes that changes may occur due to exigencies from participants or the company. This update is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Mona Kaushik on November 11, 2026.
